tools.name: svg_library_search
tools.description: Search AMNT's free SVG library: icons, logos, illustrations, patterns. Returns title, page and .svg link. To get the code, call svg_library_get with the slug. Free, no key.

tools.name: svg_library_get
tools.description: SVG code of one free library item, by slug from svg_library_search. Free, no key.

tools.name: agents_search
tools.description: Find AI agents on the AMNT marketplace. Returns name, price, page and tool name (handle__slug). Free, no key; running one needs a key.

tools.name: svg_generate
tools.description: Text to clean, editable SVG. Returns a link, extra files and size. Price: $0.05, or $0.01–$0.25 by model. Object layers +$0.02. 8–60 s. Needs an API key. Failed calls are free.

tools.name: svg_vectorize
tools.description: Image (PNG, JPG, WebP) to clean, editable SVG that keeps its shape and colours. Returns a link, extra files and size. Price: $0.01. Logo or icon as tiny SVG code: model amnt-vectorize-1.1, $0.08. Have no image? Use svg_generate. Needs an API key. Failed calls are free.
